# Asygn Colibry Camera and Hardware Driver References

Selected source-code references copied from the installed Asygn Colibry SDK.

## Included modules

- components_drivers/BOARDS — board-level camera initialization
- components_drivers/EIS316 — EIS316 camera driver
- components_drivers/HM0360 — HM0360 camera driver
- components_drivers/PAG7920LT — PAG7920LT camera driver
- colibry_drivers/CAMIF — camera interface
- colibry_drivers/DMA — DMA controller
- colibry_drivers/NNPA — neural processing accelerator
- colibry_drivers/SCU — system control unit

Some optional directories may be absent if they are not present in the
installed SDK version.

## Original source

Source root: ~/colibryNPU_SDK

These are reference copies, not a complete standalone SDK or build tree.
The original SDK installation remains unchanged.
